name: seo-bw-extension
description: Instant SEO analysis: scores, meta tags, headings, schema, links, and tech stack detection. Dev tooling only — the extension itself ships as extension/ (manifest.json + lib/ + src/, no build step).

scripts.build: echo 'No build step needed - load unpacked in Chrome'
scripts.check:zip: npm run zip && (node scripts/check-zip-manifest.mjs; rc=$?; rm -f seo-bw-extension.zip; exit $rc)
